No check enforced that rule. A new test suite reads Markdown files under `src/`, except files under an `evals` or `node_modules` directory. It makes `make ci` fail when a file names a model id that the table omits. The patterns do not catch Anthropic aliases such as `sonnet`."},{"field":"/risk/rows/0/evidence","section_digest":"e4e652706a0bc54e694c87f612e4805a9018744afef1b98e8fc30b1c144cb299","text":"The patterns are case-sensitive. The lint passes on the real tree of 94 files."},{"field":"/risk/rows/0/recovery","section_digest":"57b5ef5e6827a9b71e8f96369b02f3e8408d26d2ce2984b702fdd98272670c27","text":"Delete the test file. Nothing ships from it."},{"field":"/changes/0/text","section_digest":"27153b2419b2c8bfd1f0235ff52922c4d64ba2610fec9f111481f1ef964d30a2","text":"A pytest suite beside the delegation skill fails when it finds an unlisted model id. It also fails when a table row elsewhere names any id or when the routing table changes shape."},{"field":"/changes/1/text","section_digest":"2e0def8823310cda9fc7988c8fccc0496ef15cc5edc3ee2511ab7a01e67658fe","text":"Each vendor naming scheme has one case-sensitive pattern. A family name in prose does not count as an id."},{"field":"/changes/2/text","section_digest":"7106267a4b7c81e14fc67720ad37266acbe9b056d06647abe57c748106e782f6","text":"The routing file's Providers table became a list. The lint allows two tables there."},{"field":"/design_notes","section_digest":"30ac5fe94a67b75da7171c636fd3c0b15ed45fb15e9822257696f6d5113ac012","text":"The lint is a PEP 723 pytest suite. The content gate finds it by its `*_test.py` name. The installer's ignore file already keeps it out of the deploy, so nothing here ships.

The suite reads Markdown files under `src/`. It skips paths under an `evals` or `node_modules` directory. The suite fails when a file names a model id that the routing table's models table omits. It also fails when a table row outside the routing table names any model id. Such a row would create a second inventory. The suite fails if the tier grid gains a column. It fails if the models table gains, drops or renames a column. It also fails if the routing file holds a third table. The suite fails if the routing table is absent or lists no model id.

Six patterns cover the Claude, GPT and Gemini schemes. Three more cover the OpenRouter schemes for Gemini, Kimi and GLM. An OpenRouter id needs its vendor prefix. A file name that contains only a model family is not an id. Anthropic aliases are ordinary words. No pattern reads them as ids.

The Providers table was a third table in the routing file. Each row became one sentence with the same three facts. Every other line of the file is unchanged.

All 34 cases failed against a stub lint that returned no files and no violations. Every case passes at the head."},{"field":"/discovered/rows/0/reason","section_digest":"868e4313ef1bbdd9195ded714c62962f17282afe029401f0e4c13348830a975d","text":"The spec defines ids by vendor naming scheme. An alias is not an id."},{"field":"/criteria/0/promise","section_digest":"17717dea7bd2fdeae85e3a07eabe47bbcbf241853012a05bc50a4e8ad94047e8","text":"The lint fails on an unlisted model id in any Markdown file it reads under `src/`. It names the file and id."},{"field":"/criteria/2/promise","section_digest":"16977f38fd6f48e9a8aeb59ee6d7dc0c777f803ccf55387ab81fc56f528bd279","text":"A fenced example with a listed id fails if its row is removed."},{"field":"/criteria/3/promise","section_digest":"3ef8c0c669a8b14b4f62032b3ec62291e2e26f3ce660df98f2c67c5261357cfe","text":"The lint does not read an `evals` directory."},{"field":"/criteria/4/promise","section_digest":"4285235cade12787cf824747a95e9a2cf67d64a4b932a7531452c1a094808ef0","text":"The lint fails and names the routing table if it is absent or empty."},{"field":"/criteria/5/promise","section_digest":"75cc808240ee9324f5b1196c94e21c6c9b6b2021f51d4f960cd3d198fc72d5f0","text":"The lint fails when a table row elsewhere names a listed id. It passes when the same id appears in prose."},{"field":"/criteria/6/promise","section_digest":"2916cc81739f8cddbaedadc19a70cfffe05fa4008feca5aea5fe657077fc71de","text":"The routing table keeps its two tables. It also keeps their columns."},{"field":"/commit/why","section_digest":"fa05ee0d3786a10ffbca96306f5eb85797d60c18e829afbdcacec21445ef6e5a","text":"The routing table is meant to be the only inventory of model ids. No check enforced that rule."},{"field":"/commit/change","section_digest":"1fc1557208855e5f2bda009d4ab0e68f9de71602b90f5f83375fc14970b8e452","text":"A pytest suite beside the delegation skill reads Markdown files under src/, except files under an evals or node_modules directory. It fails when a file names a model id the routing table omits. It also fails when a table row elsewhere names any model id. It fails if the routing table changes shape. The routing file's Providers table becomes a list. The lint allows two tables there."},{"field":"/commit/verification","section_digest":"e18309e147af46095ddceabe921bbbe68910073084ebb396ea5c7968b73cc2a9","text":"At the head, `make ci` exits 0 and 20 content suites pass. All 34 cases fail against a stub lint and pass at the head. An unlisted id appended to a skill made the gate exit 2 and name the line. The patterns do not catch Anthropic aliases. No review round ran."}],"questions":[{"field":"/risk/rows/0/evidence","question":"What evidence supports the risk that the lint rejects a word that is not a model id? The current evidence says the real tree of 94 files lints clean."},{"field":"/changes/1/text","question":"Please add a Heads-up row for the caveat that Anthropic aliases such as `sonnet` are not caught."}]}
